summary: Make migration status checks read-only and coordinate them with runners
details: Stop creating schema_migrations during pending-version and readiness checks; missing tracking reports the local catalog as pending without schema writes.
Hold a shared schema-scoped advisory lock on one connection while checking, wait for updated migration runners, allow concurrent readers, and preserve cancellation and owned cleanup.
Query only expected catalog versions against an explicitly quoted schema table, preserving catalog order and bounding output by the input list instead of reading unrelated history.

compatibility.notes: No SQL files or recorded versions change. Uninitialized tracking is now reported rather than created by checking. Existing automatic migration settings still apply; SkipMigrations checks and readiness can use read-only connections.

security: State checking executes no migration DDL or mutations. Schema identifiers use pgx.Identifier quoting and version values are bound parameters. Shared lock acquisition and cleanup retain cancellation-safe physical-session ownership.
limitations: Version-name checking is not schema-content or checksum verification and does not force production startup to disable automatic migrations.
Immutable input snapshots, explicit targets, checksum and legacy-row handling, the dedicated migration job, worker operations and final deployment/runbook qualification remain in EVY-1206.
